intermediate.name: Via Consiglio Mezzano
intermediate.title: KOM Sprint (3) Via Consiglio Mezzano (149.5 km)

story: A 14-rider group established after 40 km. UAE Team Emirates maintained the gap within 3 minutes and controlled the final climbs. After Narváez's acceleration, only him, Pogačar, and Vacek remained, but Narváez dropped. Pogačar and Vacek failed to join the leaders. The sprint of six remaining breakaway riders ended with an easy win for Grégoire.
